title: Reading and Manipulating Activity Data
text: actibase foundation layer actigraphy activity data. focuses raw file reading, standardization, calibration, resampling, activity counts, non-wear detection, transformation bookkeeping. Higher-level summarization, step-count mapping, downstream statistical analysis meant live overlay packages build top core package.

title: Reading and Manipulating Activity Data
text: package ships small GT3X file small CWA file inst/extdata. use examples . GT3X reader uses read.gt3x::read.gt3x() underneath, CWA reader uses GGIRread::readAxivity(). need inspect GT3X metadata separately, acti_info_gt3x() parses header information without returning full data stream. readers also let control timezone handling explicitly. Setting apply_tz = FALSE keeps timestamps stored file, tz = NULL disables final timezone forcing step. Internally, Axivity files use fixed UTC offsets. helper maps offsets Olson timezone names small useful need reason conversion logic:
code: gt3x_file = acti_example_gt3x() cwa_file = acti_example_cwa()  gt3x = acti_read_gt3x(gt3x_file, verbose = FALSE) cwa = acti_read_cwa(cwa_file, verbose = FALSE)  class(gt3x) [1] "tbl_df"     "tbl"        "data.frame" names(gt3x) [1] "time" "X"    "Y"    "Z"    class(cwa) [1] "tbl_df"     "tbl"        "data.frame" names(cwa) [1] "time"    "x"       "y"       "z"       "temp"    "battery" "light" info = acti_info_gt3x(gt3x_file) names(info)  [1] "Serial Number"      "Device Type"        "Firmware"            [4] "Battery Voltage"    "Sample Rate"        "Start Date"          [7] "Stop Date"          "Last Sample Time"   "TimeZone"           [10] "Download Date"      "Board Revision"     "Unexpected Resets"  [13] "Acceleration Scale" "Acceleration Min"   "Acceleration Max"   [16] "Subject Name"       "Serial Prefix" gt3x_no_tz = acti_read_gt3x(   gt3x_file,   tz = NULL,   apply_tz = FALSE,   verbose = FALSE,   fill_zeroes = FALSE )  cwa_no_tz = acti_read_cwa(   cwa_file,   tz = NULL,   apply_tz = FALSE,   verbose = FALSE )  get_transformations(gt3x_no_tz) [1] "acti_read_gt3x:attributes_set" "acti_read_gt3x:data_read"      get_transformations(cwa_no_tz) [1] "acti_read_cwa:data_read_via_readAxivity" tzoffset_to_tz(c("+00:00", "-05:00", "+01:00")) [1] "Etc/GMT0"  "Etc/GMT-5" "Etc/GMT+1"
